findings: ASPEN filter factsheet, both pages text and renders reviewed: 1.2 micron for all PN, downstream of the lipid/AA-dextrose Y-site, manufacturer priming, no unfiltered bypass, delayed precipitation and medication compatibility precautions.

ASPEN adult ILE factsheet, both pages text and renders reviewed: product-specific composition, rate and allergy review; hold/limit ILE above 400 mg/dL; prolonged lipid omission risks EFAD; irreversible coalescence/oiling differs from reversible early aggregation/creaming.

ASPEN order-review checklist, both pages text and renders reviewed: independent calculations/transcription checks, clinical and pharmaceutical review; calcium/phosphate solubility and TNA emulsion constraints can compete.

USP current chapter DOI is version 07_01 (2023); module currently links older 06_01 (2022). Official December2023 FAQ explains Category1/2/3, individualized BUD with stability/sterility controls and manufacturer instructions. BUD and administration hang time are distinct. Relevant FAQ text read; rendered relevant pages still pending.

CDC February2024 summary of 2011 guidelines read: aseptic access, hub disinfection, minimum necessary lumens and no routine anticoagulation solely for infection prevention. Dedicated PN lumen infection-prevention evidence is unresolved; retain practical compatibility rationale without implying established reduction in infection.

ASPEN2014 safety consensus acknowledges inconsistent evidence for dedicated-lumen infection reduction while preferring a reserved infusion route to avoid coadministration. Its older filter and USP recommendations must be superseded by approved updated sources.

ASPEN2020 refeeding consensus adult Table6 and pathophysiology text read: potassium/phosphate shifts driven by insulin; magnesium decline mechanism less well elucidated. Current bank043 rationale implies the same defined insulin mechanism for all three and should be qualified after full corresponding-section review.

FDA July2025 SMOFlipid label sections2.1/2.2 reviewed for dedicated line, 1.2 micron filter, manufacturer-specific timing, admixture destabilization and discard instructions. Full monitoring/allergy sections and rendered pages still pending.
ASPEN2022 compatibility review calcium/phosphate and electrostatic mechanisms read. Further iron, trace, micronutrient and complete context review remains pending.
